newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish nine-month automotive exports up 24 pct.
newsitem.headline: Turkish nine-month automotive exports up 24 pct.

text.p: Turkish motor vehicle and automotive parts exports rose to $1.02 billion in the first nine months of 1996, up 24 percent from $825.8 million in the same 1995 period, the association of automotive industry (OSD) said.
Exports by the allied industry increased 14 percent to $604.6 million in January-September, led by $171.7 million of tyre exports which were steady when compared to a year ago.

Motor vehicle exports, rising 41 percent, totalled to $418.7 million, including $229.9 million worth passenger cars, up 34 percent and $154.1 million of buses, soaring 98 percent from the first nine months of 1995.
The OSD said total motor vehicle output firmed to 237,384 in January-September, up nine percent from the same 1995 period while car production declined three percent to 155,614.
